Gooseneck kettles

This page covers gooseneck kettles: fresh beans, a steady grind and clean water matter most.

Weigh the coffee and the water so every brew can be repeated.

Taste, change one variable, and taste again before changing anything else.

FAQ

Do I need a gooseneck kettle?

It gives you a slow, steady pour.

What temperature should the kettle hold?

Around 93 degrees for most light roasts.

Example Coffee Lab, brewing notes since 2019.
